text:
Predicates:
Nazi(x) ::: x is a Nazi German politician.
Member(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
Politician(x) ::: x is a politician.
Premises:
Nazi(heinrichSchmidt) ::: Heinrich Scmidt was a Nazi German politician.
Member(heinrichSchmidt, prussianStateParliament) ∧ Member(heinrichSchmidt, naziReichstag) ::: Heinrich Scmidt was also a member of the Prussian State Parliament and the Nazi Reichstag.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (Politician(x) ∧ Member(x, naziReichstag)) ::: No politicians are part of the Nazi Reichstag.
